title: Spanish point and click adventure game (opus 5.5)
author: pmcglock
selftext: Really into the idea of making some language learning games, and it was ridiculously easy to make with Claude. You can play in browser here if you are interested [spanishpointandclick.com](http://spanishpointandclick.com) . Totally free, no ads. Works well on mobile too.

comments.author: novokvest
comments.body: Looks very cool, but I couldn't understand almost anything... Yet I'm all for more point and click games made with AI. Please make some adventure game in English with 3rd person protagonist walking around!

replies.author: pmcglock
replies.body: Would love to but for now I’m only focused on Spanish language learning games specifically, because I’m trying to improve my own Spanish

replies.author: novokvest
replies.body: Okay, fair enough. But this game was really hard to understand for someone not trying to learn. Maybe make a game where this is expected - some English speaking protagonist ended up in a Spanish speaking country and really don't know what's going on, but gradually he'll end up understanding some words as well as situation around?

replies.author: pmcglock
replies.body: It’s just a niche game that isn’t for the total beginner level. It does require a little Spanish knowledge. I could make that more clear though for sure

replies.author: novokvest
replies.body: I get it now, it's okay. Thanks for actually making point and click game!

comments.author: guillermosan
comments.body: Yet another example, someone tailoring their game exactly to their needs/tastes. This is going to be more and more common.

comments.author: Old_Landscape5433
comments.body: Any chance you could do think for another language or give some pointers for how you got claude to produce this?

replies.author: pmcglock
replies.body:
No plan for other languages, it's mainly for personal use. Here's the prompt i used though: 

**Original prompt:**  
"lets make a point and click adventure game that helps people learn spanish. I will give you total control but i want you to keep these points in mind

avoid english translations, we want the user to immerse themselves in the language

We will need audio narration in easy to understand spanish. 

I think it may be good to have two modes a beginner and intermediate mode. Where the intermediate mode changes some of the games narration and dialog to make it faster , and more difficult vocabulary. 

The story can be young adult or mature, it isn't targeted at children"

replies.author: Old_Landscape5433
replies.body: Thank you! I'm going to check yours out. I need to brush up on my Spanish any way

comments.author: cyber_deept
comments.body: Amazing work!! I love it. How did you make this? I’ve been trying to build something similar with Claude, but I can’t seem to get anywhere near this quality. Would love to know how you approached it!

replies.author: pmcglock
replies.body:
hey, thank you! It was really just one small prompt for the base game and then i later asked it to improve the graphics. After that prompts were mostly around bug fixes.
